sleep.title: Wake Up
sleep.text: Morning light is leaking through the blinds. Get out of bed.

email.title: Check Your Email
email.text: Something just pinged on your computer. Check the desk.

refs.title: Review Mars Data
refs.text: Open Mars Research on your computer or read the Mars attachment in Fieldmail.

family.title: Tell Your Family
family.text: Mom and Dad are in the living room. Share the news.

leave.title: Begin Your Journey
leave.text: Leave home through the front door and head for the airport.

city.title: Reach the Airport
city.text: Follow the street east, then head north through the airport gate to the terminal.

book.title: Book a Flight
book.text: Use the ticket kiosk to choose a destination, then board at the gate on your pass.

wadi.title: Survey the Field Site
wadi.text: Open Field Records at the sample collector to log three measurements.

compare.title: Compare Your Findings
compare.text: Open Earth–Mars Analysis and compare your Earth observations with a Mars reference.

submit.title: Submit a Discovery
submit.text: Submit your comparison report to the challenge.

done.title: Field Season Open
done.text: Keep sampling, refine comparisons, or import new hackathon data.
